reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch read Job 38:22's 'treasures of the snow' as a figure for God's readiness to act, not a literal storehouse, leaving Ecclesiastes' water cycle undisturbed.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells flags Job 38:22's snow and hail treasuries as a literal storehouse cosmology beside Ecclesiastes' commonsense picture of rivers cycling back to their source.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow
sides.verseText: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, Or have you seen the treasures of the hail,

sides.snippet: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full.
sides.verseText: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
